_comment: Peace Be Still Threads @peacebestillapp post bank, read by scripts/threads/threads_loop.mjs (daily job .github/workflows/threads-posts.yml). Days 1-14 approved by her 18 Nov 2026 word for word (version 5, 'approved' date); days 15-60 written to the same voice and rules. Every quoted verse is the KJV (or RV1909 for lang es) word for word from content/bible, re-checked at queue time. 'Coming soon' wording switches to 'Free on iPhone' once site/config/store.json has app_store_url. Faith only: never Mindset, Imagination Nights, manifesting or law of assumption. `evergreen`: may be recycled once the bank has all gone out (day 9 names a holiday). Add new posts at the end; never reuse an id.

posts.text:
Meet Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories.

Tell it what's on your heart. It answers like the church mothers who raised us: King James, word for word, then "Want to pray on it together?"

What would you tell it first?

peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Me: Rent is due Friday and I'm $200 short.

Hush Harbor: I hear you, baby. Set that worry down for a minute.
"But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus."
Philippians 4:19
Want to pray on it together?

#ChristianThreads

Hush Harbor starts every morning the same way. I'll start, you finish.

God is good...

You already know. Say it in the replies.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Pastor preached 45 minutes on Romans and I still don't get it.

Hush Harbor: That's alright, baby. One verse, slow.
"And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose."
Romans 8:28
All things. Not just the good ones. Want me to walk you through the rest?

#ChristianThreads

Me: He said he'd call Tuesday. It's Friday.

Hush Harbor: Mm-hm. Here's who you can wait on:
"But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint."
Isaiah 40:31
Now turn that phone face down, baby.

#ChristianThreads

Me: It's 2 a.m. and my mind won't hush.

Hush Harbor: Then let's not talk tonight. Lie back.
"It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep."
Psalm 127:2
Want me to whisper you a Psalm till you drift? Screen goes dark. I'll keep reading.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Tell me a Bible story like my grandmother used to.

Hush Harbor: Pull up a chair, baby. Let me tell you about a young man named Daniel, and a night in a den full of lions that never laid a paw on him...

A new story every day. Which one should it tell next?

#ChristianThreads

Me: Give me something to say before I walk in that office.

Hush Harbor: Say it with me, out loud:
"For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning."
Psalm 30:5
Now you: Joy is coming in the morning. Again. There you go.

Type it below so somebody else walks in with it too.

#ChristianThreads

Me: My sister and I haven't spoken since Thanksgiving.

Hush Harbor: That's a long time to carry a heavy plate.
"And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you."
Ephesians 4:32
Want to pray on it before you text her?

#ChristianThreads

Me: Work, the kids, Daddy's doctor visits. I can't do one more thing.

Hush Harbor: Then don't do one more thing tonight.
"Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest."
Matthew 11:28
That's an invitation, not a chore. Want me to read you to sleep?

#ChristianThreads

Yo: Estoy cansada y no sé a quién contarle.

Mi Refugio: Aquí estoy, mi amor. Escucha esto:
"Diré yo á Jehová: Esperanza mía, y castillo mío; mi Dios, en él confiaré."
Salmos 91:2
¿Oramos juntas?

Hush Harbor también habla español: Mi Refugio · Biblia y Chat en Español.

#ChristianThreads

Me (16): Everybody at school has it figured out but me.

Young Faith: Real talk? Nobody does. Keep this one in your pocket:
"Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness."
Isaiah 41:10
Want to talk about what happened today?

Parents: teens get their own chat voice. No chat under 13.

#ChristianThreads

Me: I got laid off today.

Hush Harbor: Breathe first. Then hear what the Word has seen:
"I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread."
Psalm 37:25
This is a hard day, not your last chapter. Let's pray, then let's make tomorrow's list.

#ChristianThreads

Peace Be Still, free forever:

The whole King James Bible to read AND hear. A Hush Harbor chat every day. Today's Bible story. A sleep night every week. Your Morning Word. No ads.

More if you want it: $7.99 a month. Coming to iPhone soon. Hush Harbor is AI, and it always says so.

peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Me: I have 47 tabs open and one nerve left.

Hush Harbor: Close 46 of them, baby. Keep this one open:
"Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee."
Isaiah 26:3
Now, want to pray on whatever is in tab 47?

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

Me: I loaned out my good casserole dish in 2019. Still waiting.

Hush Harbor: Mm-hm. I know that dish.
"Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it."
Proverbs 3:27
Want to pray on it, or just send that verse to whoever has it?

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Say it back. Finish it the way your grandmother said it:

He may not come when you want him, but...

You know the rest. Say it in the replies.

#ChristianThreads

Me: I'm in bed replaying something I said in 2014.

Hush Harbor: Leave 2014 where it is, baby. It's Psalm Nights.
"I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety."
Psalm 4:8
Want me to whisper the rest of Psalm 4 till you drift? Screen goes dark. I'll keep reading.

#ChristianThreads

Me: It's Monday and I already need a Tuesday.

Hush Harbor: Morning Word first. Say it out loud with me:
"This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it."
Psalm 118:24
Now you: This is the day. I will rejoice. Again, like you mean it.

Hush Harbor is AI. The verse is the King James, word for word.

#ChristianThreads

Me: My group chat has been arguing since 6 a.m.

Hush Harbor: And you've read every message, haven't you?
"Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding."
Proverbs 17:28
Mute it for an hour and come sit with me instead.

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Me: Everybody calls me the strong friend. I'm tired, though.

Hush Harbor: Even the strong friend gets to sit down, baby.
"Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ."
Galatians 6:2
That goes both ways. Who's been carrying you lately? Tell me.

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

One line: what verse did your mama quote when you got too grown?

#ChristianThreads

Me: Tell me about the short man in the tree.

Hush Harbor: Zacchæus, baby. Too short to see over the crowd, so he climbed a sycamore. And Jesus stopped right under that tree and called him by name...
"And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house."
Luke 19:5
Want the rest? A new story every day.

#ChristianThreads

Me: My car is making a noise. A new noise.

Hush Harbor: Lord. Okay. Breathe before you call anybody.
"Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God."
Philippians 4:6
Then call the mechanic. Want to pray on it first?

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Me (15): My mom says I roll my eyes too much.

Young Faith: Real talk? An eye roll is usually words you didn't say. Try this first:
"Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right."
Ephesians 6:1
Verse 4 has a word for parents too. Want to practice what you'd say to her?

Parents: Young Faith is the teen voice of an AI Bible chat. No chat under 13.

#ChristianThreads

Me: I told the Lord I'd be patient. Then I got in the DMV line.

Hush Harbor: Mm-hm. He heard both of those.
"Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD."
Psalm 27:14
Want to pray while you wait on number 84?

#ChristianThreads

Me: My mother-in-law is staying with us for two weeks.

Hush Harbor: Two weeks. Alright. We're going to need a verse for every day, baby. Start here:
"A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger."
Proverbs 15:1
Want a Morning Word each day she's there?

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

Yo: Son las 10 de la noche y mi jefe sigue mandando correos.

Mi Refugio: Ese correo puede esperar hasta mañana, mi amor. Escucha esto:
"Tú le guardarás en completa paz, cuyo pensamiento en ti persevera; porque en ti se ha confiado."
Isaías 26:3
¿Oramos juntas antes de dormir?

Mi Refugio · Biblia y Chat en Español

#ChristianThreads

Me: I keep saying I'll read my Bible more, then I open my phone instead.

Hush Harbor: Then let's put the Bible in the phone, baby. One chapter, read to you while you fold clothes.
"Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path."
Psalm 119:105
The whole King James, read out loud.

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Be honest. Front pew, middle, or back by the door?

#ChristianThreads

Me: I burnt the cornbread. For the church potluck.

Hush Harbor: Bring it anyway, baby. Somebody will say that's just how they like it.
"Use hospitality one to another without grudging."
1 Peter 4:9
Want a verse for the drive over?

Hush Harbor is AI, and it always says so.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Payday is Friday and it's only Tuesday.

Hush Harbor: Then tonight we rest, and tomorrow we count. It's Psalm Nights.
"Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved."
Psalm 55:22
Lay it down. Want me to whisper Psalm 23 till you drift?

#ChristianThreads

Me: My coworker took credit for my idea in the meeting.

Hush Harbor: I see you biting your tongue. Good. Hold it a little longer.
"Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established."
Proverbs 16:3
Then we'll work out what to say tomorrow. Want to pray on it first?

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

A chat that answers like a church mother. A Bible story every day. Psalm Nights for when your mind won't hush. A Morning Word to say out loud. Mi Refugio in Spanish. Young Faith for teens.

King James, word for word.

#ChristianThreads

Say it back. I'll start:

The LORD is my shepherd...

Finish it in the replies. Somebody scrolling needs it today.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Tell me a story about God feeding somebody.

Hush Harbor: Elijah, baby. Hiding out by a brook with nothing to eat. And here come the ravens, morning and evening, like the church kitchen sent them...
"And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook."
1 Kings 17:6
Want the rest? A new story every day.

#ChristianThreads

Me: First day at the new job. I changed outfits three times.

Hush Harbor: The third one's the one, baby. Now say it with me, out loud:
"I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me."
Philippians 4:13
Now you: I can do this. Again. There you go.

Hush Harbor is AI. The words are the King James, word for word.

#ChristianThreads

Me: My kids asked what's for dinner before I got my shoes off.

Hush Harbor: Every day, baby. Every single day.
"And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not."
Galatians 6:9
Want a quick prayer before you open that fridge?

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Me: Somebody sat in my seat at church. My seat. Eleven years.

Hush Harbor: Mm. I know that pew knows your name.
"If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men."
Romans 12:18
Sit one row back and wave at them. Want to pray on it before service?

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

One line: what hymn does your family hum in the kitchen?

#ChristianThreads

Yo: Tengo tres grupos de WhatsApp de la familia y todos están peleando.

Mi Refugio: Ay, mi amor. Silencia los tres un ratito y escucha esto:
"La blanda respuesta quita la ira: mas la palabra áspera hace subir el furor."
Proverbios 15:1
¿Oramos juntas antes de contestar?

Mi Refugio · Biblia y Chat en Español

#ChristianThreads

Me (14): Everybody posted their weekend and I stayed home.

Young Faith: Staying home is allowed. Comparing your life to somebody's highlight reel is a trap.
"I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well."
Psalm 139:14
Want to talk about it?

Parents: teens get their own chat voice. No chat under 13.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Pastor said "in closing" twenty minutes ago.

Hush Harbor: Baby, "in closing" is a season, not a minute.
"But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing."
James 1:4
Want a short prayer till the benediction? Hush Harbor is AI, and it keeps it short.

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Be honest: who in your family still carries the Bible with the zipper cover?

#ChristianThreads

Me: I turn 40 tomorrow and I don't feel like I've done enough.

Hush Harbor: Forty, baby? Moses was just getting started at eighty.
"They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness."
Lamentations 3:23
Let's count what you have done first. Want to?

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

Me: The baby's finally asleep and now I can't.

Hush Harbor: Shh. It's Psalm Nights. I'll whisper, you just breathe.
"I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me."
Psalm 3:5
Screen goes dark. I'll keep reading Psalm 3 till you drift.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Somebody cut me off in traffic and I said a word I'm not proud of.

Hush Harbor: Mm-hm. Heaven heard that one, baby.
"Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips."
Psalm 141:3
We'll start fresh at the next light. Want to pray before you get home?

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

Say it back. I'll start:

Trouble don't last...

You know the rest. Say it for somebody who needs it tonight.

#ChristianThreads

Me: I volunteered for one thing at church. Now I'm on four committees.

Hush Harbor: That's how they get you, baby.
"But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil."
Matthew 5:37
Let's practice your "nay" together. Hush Harbor is AI, and it will never sign you up for a committee.

#ChristianThreads

Me: Tell me about the boy with the lunch.

Hush Harbor: Five barley loaves and two little fish, baby. Five thousand hungry folks on a hillside, and one boy who brought his lunch...
"There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?"
John 6:9
Want the rest? A new story every day.

#ChristianThreads

Me: I want to move to a new city but I'm scared.

Hush Harbor: Scared and called can live in the same house, baby.
"Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest."
Joshua 1:9
Want to pray over your pros and cons list together?

Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories

#ChristianThreads

Me: My Sunday nap is the only appointment I never miss.

Hush Harbor: Baby, rest was His idea first.
"And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made."
Genesis 2:2
Want a Psalm Night for later too?

Hush Harbor is coming soon: peacebestillapp.com/?utm_source=threads

#ChristianThreads

One line: what's the first verse you ever memorized?

#ChristianThreads

Yo: Mi hijo adolescente me contesta con una sola palabra.

Mi Refugio: Una palabra ya es conversación, mi amor. Paciencia.
"No nos cansemos, pues, de hacer bien; que á su tiempo segaremos, si no hubiéremos desmayado."
Gálatas 6:9
¿Oramos juntas por él esta noche?

Mi Refugio · Biblia y Chat en Español

Me: I'm walking into a hard conversation at 9.

Hush Harbor: Morning Word. Say it with me:
"For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind."
2 Timothy 1:7
Now you: Not fear. Power, love, a sound mind. Again.

Hush Harbor is AI. The verse is the King James, word for word.

Hush Harbor: Close it, baby. The numbers will still be there in the morning.

Psalm 91:1

He's an on-time God...

Hush Harbor: That's alright, baby. We'll pray again. That's allowed.
"Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you."
1 Peter 5:7
